questions.q: Football makes our heart and ______ strong.
questions.passage: There is a new TV program about the importance of sports. It explains that sports help us stay healthy and give us more energy. There are many sports we can do. For example, football makes our heart and muscles strong. Swimming helps the whole body and the lungs. Sports also help us look fit and make our bones stronger. A simple exercise can reduce stress and improve sleep. This supports mental health. If you feel tired during exercising, you can rest for a while and drink water.
